definitions.gloss: guide map; information map; directory map
definitions.explanation: A map displayed at a location to help visitors find their way around. Commonly found at stations, parks, shopping centers, tourist spots, and large buildings.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{案内図|あんないず}があった。
examples.english: There was a guide map in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {案内図|あんないず}で{現在地|げんざいち}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked my current location on the guide map.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}の{入口|いりぐち}にある{案内図|あんないず}を{見|み}て、{散歩|さんぽ}コースを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: I looked at the guide map at the park entrance and decided on a walking route.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {案内|あんない} (guidance, information) + {図|ず} (map, diagram). Refers to the kind of map that is posted at a location to orient visitors, not a portable map you carry. Extremely common in Japan at train stations, parks, shopping malls, and tourist sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {案内図|あんないず}を{見|み}る (to look at a guide map)
- {館内|かんない}{案内図|あんないず} (building directory/floor map)
- {周辺|しゅうへん}{案内図|あんないず} (area guide map)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地図|ちず}: map — a general portable map, not limited to on-site information boards
- {見取|みと}り{図|ず}: floor plan, layout — shows the internal layout of a building
